objective_checks.detail: changing docs/guide.md routes as expected across 3 workflow(s)
changing src/index.js routes as expected across 3 workflow(s)
changing README.md, LICENSE routes as expected across 3 workflow(s)
required check(s) always fire and gate internally (.github/workflows/tests.yml)
event-only workflows carry no path filters (.github/workflows/nightly-sweep.yml, .github/workflows/triage.yml)

dimensions.name: Completeness
dimensions.rationale: All five workflows received a deliberate trigger decision that the agent discovered itself, and the required `unit-tests` check was correctly handled with always-run + early-skip so it still reports a status rather than a merge-blocking trigger-level path filter.

dimensions.name: Salience
dimensions.rationale: Each workflow's path list is distinct and mapped to what that workflow plausibly consumes (deploy → src/scripts/deploy.sh, docs → docs/mkdocs.yml, tests → src/test) rather than a shared catch-all, though the npm-based jobs omit `package-lock.json`, which `npm ci` actually reads.

dimensions.name: Restraint
dimensions.rationale: The agent correctly left the schedule-only, issue-driven workflows and the branch-protection ruleset untouched, but created a brand-new AGENTS.md documentation file that the workflow audit did not call for, expanding scope beyond the requested change.
